stops.title: Crossing the Strait of Messina on His Cloak
stops.subtitle: Sweep your lantern across Fretum Siculum to uncover 3 hidden memories
stops.imageCaption: Humble brown-robed friar sailing serenely across sunlit turquoise Mediterranean waters upon a billowing woolen cloak as amazed sailors watch.
stops.whatYouCanSeeToday: Ferries cross these same sparkling waters daily, and Italian sailors still invoke St. Francis of Paola as their beloved heavenly protector.
stops.didYouKnowHighlight: Because of this famous miracle, Pope Pius XII officially declared St. Francis of Paola the Patron Saint of all Italian seafarers and maritime workers in 1943!

stops.subtitle: Sweep your lantern across Château de Plessis-lès-Tours to uncover 3 hidden memories
stops.imageCaption: Soft golden Loire Valley twilight illuminating a brick-and-limestone French royal château surrounded by tranquil autumn gardens.

stops.didYouKnowHighlight: Francis lived to be ninety-one years old—an astonishing lifespan in the fifteenth century—and was canonized just twelve years after his death!
stops.saintQuote: Live every day as though you stood in the loving presence of God.

stops.didYouKnowHighlight: Because of his boyhood roots in Droitwich, St. Richard is honored locally as a patron of salt-workers and farmers alike!
stops.saintQuote: Faithfulness in humble daily labor prepares the soul for every higher calling.

detectiveClues.clueText: During the painful Western Schism when rival popes divided Europe, Vincent was summoned to Avignon as confessor to Benedict XIII. stops.didYouKnowHighlight: Before De La Salle, pupils were taught one-on-one in Latin—he revolutionized world education by grouping students by ability and teaching them together in their native spoken language!
stops.saintQuote: God, who guides all things with wisdom and gentleness, led me without my realizing it.

globeHeaderSubtitle: Sacred Trails of St. Lidwina of Schiedam (Schiedam, South Holland, Netherlands)
completionSummary: You glided across the wintry Dutch canals of St. Lidwina of Schiedam, Patron Saint of Ice Skaters and the Chronically Ill—whose childhood skating accident at age fifteen opened thirty-eight years of radiant joy, mysticism, and comfort for suffering neighbors.

stops.title: The Winter Ice-Skating Accident
stops.subtitle: Sweep your lantern across Schie Canal, Schiedam to uncover 3 hidden memories
stops.imageCaption: Crisp golden Dutch winter afternoon with wooden windmills and brick gabled houses reflected beside skaters gliding across a frozen canal.
stops.whatYouCanSeeToday: The picturesque historic canals and towering windmills of Schiedam still recall the famous fifteenth-century winter scene depicted in the oldest known printed woodcut of ice skating!
stops.didYouKnowHighlight: A 1498 woodcut illustrating St. Lidwina’s fall on the ice is famous among sports historians as one of the very earliest printed pictures of ice-skating in European history!
stops.saintQuote: Even a broken path on winter ice can lead straight into the warmth of God’s heart.

stops.title: Thirty-Eight Years of Radiant Comfort

On April 21, 1962, healthy baby Gianna Emanuela was born; one week later, on April 28, Gianna went peacefully to God.

hiddenArtifacts.foundTitle: Building the Great Abbey of Cluny III

stops.saintQuote: Walk humbly before God, whether tending sheep in a field or shepherding the world.

stops.title: Keeping the White Habit at Santa Sabina, Rome

stops.imageCaption: Warm sunlit Roman cloister orange grove where an elderly gentle Pope dressed in a simple pure white wool Dominican habit reads parchment pages.

stops.didYouKnowHighlight: Pius V was also one of the first European leaders to issue a papal bull condemning cruel bullfighting as an inhumane spectacle—showing surprising tenderness for God’s creatures!
stops.saintQuote: All the evils of the world come from lukewarmness; let charity burn bright and clear.
